summary: Verified EF Core 'First/FirstOrDefault without OrderBy' warning fix in Areas/CAM/Controllers/DashboardController.cs. Static inspection, clean build, dedicated repro probe, and full B2C regression suite (66 checks) all PASS. Main agent's diagnosis and fix are confirmed correct and non-invasive.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is minimal and correct: adding .OrderBy(x => x.Interpreted) and .OrderBy(x => x.Total) before FirstOrDefaultAsync on a GroupBy(_ => 1) aggregate is a no-op semantically (aggregate produces at most one row) and only silences EF's heuristic warning EF1000/QueryFirstWithoutOrderByAndFilterWarning. No behavioral change.

grep 'GroupBy(_ => 1)' across the C# codebase returns exactly the two hits in DashboardController, both now guarded by OrderBy. No other unfiltered/unordered First/FirstOrDefault aggregate queries remain.

Warning severity: NOT serious. It is a heuristic ('may lead to unpredictable results'). Since the source is a single-row aggregate, First was already deterministic before the fix — no wrong data was ever returned to users on the CAM dashboard. Fix is purely log-hygiene.

Repro probe /app/probe/Program.cs confirms: old shape emits 1 EF warning, new shape emits 0. Aggregate values remain identical (Total=2, Interpreted=4). Clinic-with-no-batches still returns null with no warning.
seed_data_creation: None (probes use in-memory / SQL Server compile-only paths).
context_for_next_testing_agent: C# ASP.NET Core MVC project /app/MedicalApp (net9.0). dotnet lives at /root/.dotnet — export PATH first. App cannot start here (points at PINTILIE\SQLEXPRESS on user's machine). Regression probes: /app/probe (EF warning repro), /app/memory/probes/bg_interpretation (66-check B2C suite; needs a tiny fix — constructor of PendingRegistrationStore now requires IDistributedCache: pass `new MemoryDistributedCache(Options.Create(new MemoryDistributedCacheOptions()))`). CamFileStoreContractProbe.cs.txt and ScaleOutProbe.cs.txt not exercised in this run (require Azurite + project scaffolding); skipped as instructed.
rca of the issue: RCA: EF Core 9 emits a debug-level heuristic warning (CoreEventId.FirstWithoutOrderByAndFilterWarning) whenever a translated query ends with First/FirstOrDefault but the underlying SQL has no WHERE + ORDER BY. The two dashboard aggregates use GroupBy(_ => 1).Select(...).FirstOrDefaultAsync() to pull a single aggregated row (KPI totals and batch counts by status). Even though the aggregate produces at most one row (grouping constant is 1), EF's static analyzer cannot prove that and emits the warning twice — once from PopulateStatsAsync (~L165) and once from ComputeBatchPeriodRangeAsync (~L303). Mitigation applied by main agent: add a trivial .OrderBy(x => x.<col>) before FirstOrDefaultAsync in both spots. This silences EF's heuristic without changing SQL semantics (ORDER BY over a single-row result is a no-op). Confirmed by probe: 1 warning -> 0 warnings, identical result set. Severity assessment: LOW / cosmetic — never produced wrong data.
